title: Scheduled EventBridge to Lambda
scenario: Trigger a Lambda every five minutes using an EventBridge rule and a target, with invoke permission.

focus.title: Complete the scheduled function
focus.todo: Configure the function runtime, handler, role and memory for the scheduled job.

hints.why: Lambda packages compute as a small, event-driven unit. The code artifact, execution role and trigger are the contract to get right.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_lambda_function" "this"`. Configure the function runtime, handler, role and memory for the scheduled job. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use Lambda for short-lived event handlers or glue code where managing a server would add cost and operational noise.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_lambda_function" "this"`. Use this code shape: function_name; runtime; handler; filename; memory_size; role; environment { variables }. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.lambda_role_arn`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
